question: Which DRDO-developed missile is India's first indigenous air-launched anti-ship missile?
solution:
The correct answer is __**NASM-SR**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **NASM-SR (Naval Anti-Ship Missile – Short Range)** is India’s first **indigenous air-launched anti-ship missile** developed by the **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO).**
 
• It was successfully test-fired in **May 2022** from the Indian Navy's Sea Harrier fighter aircraft, marking a significant milestone in India's defense capabilities.
 
• The missile is designed to be launched from aircraft and targets enemy warships, providing precision strike capability. *Hence, NASM-SR is the correct answer.*
 
• **Key features:** The missile is equipped with **state-of-the-art navigation and guidance systems**, ensuring high accuracy in hitting targets.
 
• It has a **range of approximately 55 km** and is capable of engaging medium-range targets with high precision.
 
• NASM-SR enhances India’s maritime strike capabilities and strengthens the defense of coastal regions and naval operations.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is NASM-SR.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Other Missiles Mentioned:**

 
 
• **BrahMos:** A joint venture between India and Russia, BrahMos is a **supersonic cruise missile** used for land, air, and sea-based platforms. Its high speed and precision make it one of the fastest cruise missiles globally.
 
• **Varunastra:** An **anti-submarine torpedo** developed by DRDO, used by the Indian Navy. It is not an air-launched missile but operates underwater to target submarines.
 
• **Astra:** Astra is India’s **indigenous air-to-air missile** designed for fighter aircraft. It is not anti-ship but is primarily used for aerial combat.
 
 
 
• **NASM-SR Characteristics:**
 
 
• **Launch Platform:** Designed to be launched from aircraft, enhancing the Indian Navy’s operational capabilities.
 
• **Guidance Systems:** Equipped with advanced **navigation and guidance systems** for precision strikes.
 
• **Strategic Importance:** NASM-SR strengthens India’s maritime defense and provides a credible deterrence against enemy warships.
 
 
 
• **DRDO’s Role:**
 
 
• **Organization:** DRDO is India’s premier defense research organization responsible for developing indigenous defense technologies.
 
• **Development:** NASM-SR is a testament to DRDO’s commitment to enhancing India’s self-reliance in defense technologies.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **NASM-SR Development:**

 
 
• NASM-SR signifies India’s shift towards **self-reliance in defense manufacturing**, reducing dependence on imports.
 
• The missile enhances the **Indian Navy’s operational readiness** and contributes to modernizing its defense arsenal.
 
 
 
• **Global Context:**
 
 
• Air-launched anti-ship missiles are vital for maritime security and are used by various countries to protect territorial waters and project power.
 
• NASM-SR puts India in an elite group of nations with the capability to manufacture advanced indigenous air-launched anti-ship missiles.
